properties.title: Intervention-Aware Clinical World Model for Post-Op Outcome Forecasting in Cardiology

properties.version_basis: PDF identified by SHA-256 against assignments.json; title page read.

properties.description: Internal cross-validated evaluation of an intervention-aware latent world model for atrial fibrillation ablation recurrence and scar extent, with a separate auxiliary cohort without ablation geometry.
properties.independent_study_claim: single-cohort study; all results internal to DECAAF-II

properties.description: Frozen VAE state encoder, ablation-heatmap CNN, event Transformer with ECGFounder embeddings, 3D residual latent transition with elapsed-time drift, and recurrence and scar heads.

properties.algorithm: Intervention-aware latent clinical world model (3D spatial latent, event-token updates, horizon token)

properties.population: patients undergoing atrial fibrillation ablation, 90-day blanking period
properties.decision: recurrence risk updating and retrospective input edits; no deployment decision is defined

properties.description: DECAAF-II complete-record patients, N=91, with pre and post LGE-MRI, ablation geometry, events, ECGs, scar and recurrence labels
Auxiliary patients, N=258, without usable ablation geometry, evaluated separately
5-fold cross-validation with 3 seeds on N=91 and a separate auxiliary evaluation on N=258; fold assignment unit and hyperparameter selection set are not stated

properties.summary: AUROC, auxiliary cohort, variant without ablation map = 0.713
AUPRC, auxiliary cohort, variant without ablation map = 0.747
AUROC, ablation without latent matching loss = 0.624
AUPRC, ablation without latent matching loss = 0.686
AUROC, ablation direct fusion without step-wise evolution = 0.709
AUPRC, ablation direct fusion without step-wise evolution = 0.72

criteria_met: DECAAF-II multicenter trial cohort identified, cohort sizes and modality availability tabulated (Table 1)
Event schema and counts, preprocessing and EAM mapping described
criteria_missing: ECG source, device and timing metadata
assertions.rationale: Provenance is described at cohort level, not variable level.
Each event token carries its recorded time relative to the ablation day and the time gaps between events are used in the update.

criteria_met: Events censored at day 90 and only records available by the query horizon are used
ECG embeddings use only recordings within 7 days before an event
criteria_missing: Distinction between event time and time the record became available
assertions.rationale: Prefix rules are stated, lag semantics are not.

criteria_met: Padding is masked, unrecorded events are not imputed
criteria_missing: An explicit indicator for absent ECG, which is zero-filled
Evaluation across missingness patterns, which the authors list as unevaluated
assertions.rationale: Partial under the missing-value rule.

criteria_met: Normalized event time and queried horizon are encoded in each token
criteria_missing: Age of the ECG within its 7-day window
assertions.rationale: Time since the ablation is encoded, staleness of individual measurements is not.
Updates occur per event token and a drift term scales with the elapsed time between events divided by 30 days. The drift term is not ablated separately.

criteria_met: Event times are recorded, missing ECG and unrecorded events are not imputed
criteria_missing: A model of why events or ECGs are recorded
assertions.rationale: Observation process is represented only through event times.
No audit of recording clocks or time alignment between ECG, events and imaging is described.

criteria_met: Resampling to 1.5 mm, registration, cropping and intensity normalization are specified
Manual EAM-to-MRI mapping of ablation points
criteria_missing: Units and coding of medications and events
assertions.rationale: Image preprocessing only.

criteria_met: VAE is pretrained on a disjoint set of 732 patients
Follow-up MRI is training-only and ECGs use pre-event windows
5-fold cross-validation with 3 seeds
criteria_missing: Statement that folds are patient-level and that fold-wise preprocessing and baseline tuning exclude test folds
assertions.rationale: Several leakage barriers are stated, fold construction is not.
Data come from a multicenter trial but pooling or federation arrangements are not described.
Frozen VAE 3D anatomical encoder, ablation-heatmap CNN and ECGFounder embeddings feed the model. Removing ECGFounder, the ablation map or events lowers AUROC (Table 4).

criteria_met: ECGFounder embeddings are used as event context
criteria_missing: Checkpoint version and whether it is frozen
assertions.rationale: Named pretrained ECG foundation model, adaptation unspecified.
A latent matching loss pulls the predicted terminal latent toward the follow-up MRI latent. Removing it lowers AUROC from 0.756 to 0.624 and raises SD (Table 4). The target encoder is the frozen VAE.

assertions.applicability_reason: [design] The prediction target comes from a frozen pretrained VAE encoder rather than a jointly trained target network, so representation collapse of the target has no subject.

criteria_met: A pretrained VAE with encoder and decoder defines the latent space
criteria_missing: Any use of the decoder in this pipeline
assertions.rationale: Reconstruction is part of the pretrained encoder, not of this model's loss.
Static covariates, ablation geometry, event tokens and ECG embeddings are fused through a Transformer and conditioned 3D transitions. Removing events, the ablation map or ECG lowers AUROC (Table 4).

criteria_met: Padding masks and zero-filled absent ECG are handled in fusion
assertions.rationale: Missingness handling is partial.
A 3D spatial latent state is initialized from the baseline MRI and updated per event token. Replacing step-wise evolution with direct fusion lowers AUROC to 0.709 (Table 4).
The state update is a deterministic residual plus drift with no noise term or distribution, and the paper reports no belief over the state.

criteria_met: State is advanced between events by elapsed-time drift and conditioned on each new event token
criteria_missing: Separation of prior evolution from correction against measured observations
assertions.rationale: Propagation exists, correction against observations is not separate.

criteria_met: Forecasts at prefixes D7 to D90 incorporate events recorded so far (anytime updating)
criteria_missing: Comparison with refit or streaming cost
assertions.rationale: Evaluated retrospectively on prefixes.
No patient-specific parameter adaptation is described.
One state feeds a recurrence head and a scar-extent head and is queried at multiple horizons by changing the terminal token.
Ablations remove events, ablation map and ECG, shuffle event content and compare prefixes D7 to D90 against the recurrence target.
The state is conditioned on the ordered event history through event tokens. Removing events or shuffling event content lowers AUROC.
No swapped-patient or population-prior control is reported. Heterogeneity of edit effects is noted without an audit.

criteria_met: Residual update preserves the baseline latent by construction
Latent matching ties the final state to the follow-up anatomy latent
criteria_missing: An explicit anatomy-consistency test such as overlap with follow-up structures
assertions.rationale: Mechanism exists, test does not.

criteria_met: The latent is a 3D grid aligned with atrial anatomy and a scar-extent readout provides a structural check
criteria_missing: Inspection or visualization of latent states
Mapping of latent channels to physiology
assertions.rationale: Spatial layout only.

criteria_met: The state carries event history across tokens
assertions.rationale: History is carried through the state only.
Interventions are encoded explicitly as medication category, cardioversion and repeat-procedure flags and an ablation heatmap. They are recorded events, not a settable action space.

criteria_met: Typed flags for medication, cardioversion and repeat procedure, plus an ablation-geometry channel
criteria_missing: Defined roles for dose, target and timing beyond event time
assertions.rationale: Types exist, roles are not specified.

criteria_met: Medication category embedding and spatial ablation heatmap carry parameters
assertions.rationale: Partial parameterization.
Interventions are an ordered sequence with recorded times, normalized to the ablation day.
Coincident or linked interventions are not given defined bundle semantics.
No clinical or feasibility constraints on interventions are described.

criteria_met: Events come from procedural records and ablation points are mapped to MRI space
criteria_missing: Validation of the mapping, which the authors note may add localization error
assertions.rationale: Grounded in records, not validated.
Event counts are tabulated (3 repeat procedures) but no support or overlap analysis is done for queried edits.

criteria_met: Same-patient predictions before and after predefined edits are compared (Figure 4)
assertions.rationale: Exploratory sensitivity only.
No irreversibility or ordering constraint on interventions is described.
A learned update from the state at the previous token to the next, with elapsed-time drift. Replacing it with direct fusion lowers AUROC (Table 4).
The transition is a learned 3D residual CNN plus an MLP drift. Mechanistic components are not described, so this is learned rather than hybrid.

criteria_met: Transition is conditioned on event tokens and the ablation map
Removing events or the map and shuffling event content lowers AUROC
criteria_missing: Results under specified alternative actions with observed outcomes
Evidence that conditioning is settable beyond recorded post hoc events (3 repeat procedures)
Causal reading, which the authors disclaim
assertions.rationale: Conditioning exists and matters, settable-action prediction is not validated.
The update is deterministic and no sampling or noise term is described.
No mechanistic or physiological prior is described in the transition.
No mechanistic component is combined with the learned transition.

assertions.applicability_reason: [design] A single learned transition is used, so a multi-backend interface has no subject.

assertions.rationale: No coupled multiscale dynamics are described beyond a single elapsed-time scale.
Training uses a terminal latent matching loss plus outcome heads. No per-step or multi-step transition loss is described.
No hierarchy of options or timescales is described.

criteria_met: A VAE decoder is part of the pretrained autoencoder
criteria_missing: Use of the decoder to render predicted follow-up anatomy
assertions.rationale: No decoded follow-up image is produced.
Recurrence-probability and scar-extent heads read the terminal state.
Successor outputs are scored against references: scar extent at follow-up (MAE 2.971 versus 3.189 for a follow-up-MRI baseline) and recurrence AUROC and AUPRC against sequence baselines.

criteria_met: Sequential token updates and terminal-token horizon queries D7 to F210
assertions.rationale: Risk trajectories are shown but not scored per horizon.
The paper does not describe teacher forcing or free-running evaluation of intermediate states.

criteria_met: Forecasts at D7 to D90 incorporate newly observed events
criteria_missing: Error reduction after reassimilation measured against labels
assertions.rationale: Shown as trajectories only.

criteria_met: Recurrence window of 451 days and query horizons to F210 are stated
criteria_missing: Justification of a maximum supported horizon
assertions.rationale: Horizons are stated without validation.

criteria_met: The risk ordering changes only gradually in F120 to F210 no-new-event queries
criteria_missing: Error growth against horizon measured with labels
assertions.rationale: Qualitative stability only.
No horizon-specific error or calibration curve with an acceptance tolerance is reported.
Each query yields one deterministic prediction, with no sampled futures described.

criteria_met: Events are censored at day 90 and only records available by the query horizon are used
criteria_missing: A test that later information cannot enter the prediction
assertions.rationale: Rules are stated, enforcement is not tested.

gate_assessments.rationale: Cohort sizes and modalities are given and the VAE uses a disjoint pretraining set, but the recurrence endpoint definition, fold unit and baseline tuning set are not stated, and events such as cardioversion may follow early recurrence.
Terminal outputs are scored in internal cross-validation on 91 patients with SDs comparable to the effects, intermediate states are not evaluated and the scar-extent margin is small.
Horizon queries are shown as risk trajectories but not scored per horizon, and no maximum supported horizon is validated.
Action semantics are partial: events are recorded post hoc and edits are associational probes without matched alternative-outcome validation.
All results are internal to DECAAF-II, an auxiliary cohort without ablation geometry is a different task variant, and no external or subgroup validation is reported.

All performance results are internal 5-fold cross-validation on 91 patients with 3 seeds and SDs of the same order as many differences. The recurrence endpoint is not defined, and the blanking-period events may be consequences of early recurrence, which the paper does not discuss.
Sequence baselines reach scar MAE of 9 to 12 with SDs near the mean, which suggests unstable or untuned fits, so their comparison is of limited value.

notes: Core world model at L1: a persistent 3D latent state advanced by learned event-token transitions with a horizon token, trained with a latent matching loss to follow-up anatomy and evaluated internally for recurrence and scar extent. Legacy L2 is not adopted: conditioning on recorded events and the ablation map is shown by ablation, but no prediction under specified alternative actions is validated and input edits are associational. Source points: undefined recurrence endpoint with events that may follow early recurrence, small N, weak sequence baselines, and a code repository mentioned without an address.
